# TravelTalk: Speak & Translate

> 100% offline iOS travel dialogue simulator, in-place menu allergy scanner, survival show cards, and two-way voice translator for Japan, France, and English trips.

TravelTalk is an iPhone, iPad, and iPhone Duo app that helps travelers practice offline travel conversations, scan foreign menus with allergy alerts, and communicate via live voice translator and full-screen show cards — 100% offline with zero sign-ups and zero ads.

## Key features

- 9-Language Native Interface: Full UI localization across English, Simplified & Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, and Portuguese.
- 1,389 Studio Neural Voice Recordings: Expanded offline audio coverage across all 23 interactive scenarios, Top 100 survival cheatsheet phrases, and 38 emergency show cards.
- In-Place Menu Scanner & Allergy Guard: Translate foreign menus directly over the original photo with pinch-to-zoom, hold-to-compare, red allergen warnings, and 1-tap dish ordering cards.
- Travel Map, Offline Taxi Cards & WeatherKit Tips: Pin hotels for 1-tap local-language taxi address cards, locate nearby stations or hospitals, and get weather-matched phrases.
- Symmetrical Dual-Mic Live Voice Translator: On-device Speech Recognition and iOS 18 TranslationSession with built-in offline travel lexicon fallback.

## Facts
- Category: Travel / Education
- Platform: iPhone / iPad / iPhone Duo (iOS 18.0+)
- Bundled Offline Audio: 1,389 neural voice recordings across 23 scenarios, 100 cheatsheet phrases & 38 emergency show cards
- Supported UI Languages: 9 (en, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja, ko, de, fr, es, pt-BR)
- Price: Free ($0, zero ads, zero tracking, zero account required)

## FAQ

### Does TravelTalk work 100% offline in airplane mode or foreign subways?

Yes. TravelTalk bundles 1,389 studio-grade neural audio recordings across 23 branching travel scenarios, the Top 100 survival cheatsheet, and 38 full-screen emergency show cards right inside the app. Live two-way voice translation, VisionKit menu scanning, and saved hotel taxi cards all run on-device without Wi-Fi, roaming data, or user accounts.

### How does the offline foreign menu scanner detect food allergies?

Open Scan Menu in the Translator tab to point your camera or pick a menu photo. Apple VisionKit OCR and on-device translation render native-language stickers directly over the original menu photo while cross-checking your Travel Passport dietary tags—automatically flagging peanut, tree nut, shellfish, gluten, dairy, halal, vegetarian, cilantro, or spicy dishes in red.

### Which destination languages and app interface languages does TravelTalk support?

TravelTalk teaches and translates real-world travel conversations for Japanese (ja-JP), French (fr-FR), and English (en-US) destinations, while the app interface, phonetics, and survival meanings are 100% localized in 9 languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese.

### How do Full-Screen Show Cards and Offline Taxi Address Cards help when I cannot speak?

Every survival phrase, allergy alert, and saved map place turns into a high-contrast Full-Screen Show Card displaying your mother-tongue confirmation on top and large local-language script below. Restaurant staff or taxi drivers can read the address, hear native neural audio, and tap structured reply buttons right on your screen.

### Is TravelTalk free, and does it collect personal voice or location data?

TravelTalk is free to download on the App Store with zero ads, zero account registration, and zero third-party tracking SDKs. All speech recognition, menu OCR, saved hotel pins, and Travel Passport preferences stay strictly inside your local iPhone, iPad, or iPhone Duo SwiftData sandbox.

### Does TravelTalk support iPad and foldable iPhone Duo displays?

Yes. TravelTalk is a Universal iOS 18+ app engineered with adaptive Boarding Pass layouts for iPhone, 13-inch iPad split workspaces, and iPhone Duo—featuring one-hand cover-screen show cards on the 5.4-inch outer display and crease-safe dual microphones on the 7.6-inch unfolded display.
